architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for global state).

tickets.title: Create OnboardingStepsWidget page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_widget screen to React component. Extract reusable step indicator, progress bar, CTA button. Use CSS modules for styling. Mobile-first responsive.

tickets.title: Create OnboardingWebViewFixedTokens page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_web_view_fixed_tokens screen to React component. Embed web view for token display. Add copy-to-clipboard button. Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Error state for web view load failure

tickets.title: Create ButtonShowcaseWebView page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_web_view_final screen to React component. Extract reusable button variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, disabled). Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: All variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, disabled) implemented

tickets.title: Create ButtonShowcaseMobile page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_mobile screen to React component. Reuse Button component from TASK-003. Adjust layout for mobile constraints. Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Touch targets meet WCAG 2.1 AA (48x48px minimum)

tickets.title: Create shared layout components (Header, Footer, Layout)
tickets.description: Extract shared layout components from Stitch screens. Header with logo, nav links. Footer with legal links. Layout component for consistent page structure. Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Header and footer match Stitch design patterns
Layout component enforce consistent page structure

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App shell. Set up React Router v6. Configure routes for all pages. Add navigation bar. Implement 404 page. Use CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: React Router v6 configured with all page routes
Navigation bar matches Stitch design patterns
